projects.title: Chess ML Coach
projects.description: A chess coach that analyzes your games, identifies recurring mistakes, and creates personalized practice with Stockfish and machine learning.
highlights: Runs Stockfish analysis in the browser for hosted workflows, with resumable checkpoints and shared analysis coordination.
Uses authenticated, isolated player data with PostgreSQL-backed persistence and adaptive spaced-repetition practice.
Combines engine-grounded coaching with player-specific modelling to identify mistake-prone positions and generate personal training.

projects.title: Evalcue AI
projects.description: An interview platform for practicing and assessing coding, system design, and debugging skills with structured feedback and evaluation.
highlights: Supports role-specific practice and candidate assessments across voice, coding, system design, and multi-file debugging workflows.
Provides hiring pipelines, weighted scorecards, evidence review, and human calibration controls.
Uses Redis and BullMQ for asynchronous evaluation, with billing, observability, and production deployment safeguards.

projects.title: Ecommerce Search Engine
projects.description: An e-commerce search engine combining full-text retrieval, caching, and machine-learning-based ranking for more relevant product results.
highlights: Uses PostgreSQL full-text retrieval, Redis query/result caches, and cursor-based pagination for low-latency search.
Ranks results with LightGBM using popularity, relevance, freshness, category, price, and interaction features.
Includes personalization, event tracking, background retraining, and an A/B framework for ranking experiments.

projects.title: YAML Data Visualizer
projects.description: Explore large YAML files visually, compare changes, and collaborate on configurations without getting lost in nested structures.
highlights: Renders more than 5,000 nodes at 60fps using virtual rendering and frame scheduling.
Supports real-time collaboration, delta-based versioning, diff comparison, and secure GitHub webhook integrations.
Recent work improved diff correctness and added regression coverage to CI for the comparison workflow.

projects.title: ExitSense
projects.description: An Android app that detects when you're leaving home and reminds you what to bring, using device sensors rather than GPS.

projects.title: Developer Knowledge Base
projects.description: Organize technical notes, coding questions, and solutions in nested workspaces with Markdown editing, search, and optional AI assistance.
highlights: Supports Notion-style nested workspaces, drag-and-drop organization, pinned notes, favorites, and multiple solutions.
Combines a Markdown editor, live preview, syntax highlighting, and global search.
Provides per-user Supabase-authenticated workspaces and OpenAI-powered answer generation.

projects.title: Hackathon Portal

Managed teams, submissions, ideas, participants, and scoring through the event lifecycle.
